Trump order pushes for overhaul of childhood vaccine schedule
subhead: As the US experiences its worst measles outbreak in 35 years, the president's order coincides with children returning to school. Curbing vaccines has been a key priority for Health Secretary Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr, who has long touted a debunked link between immunization and autism.

title: Thirty years after Tupac Shakur's murder, a trial seeks to resolve a never-closed case
subhead: The trial of Duane 'Keefe D' Davis, accused of organizing and participating in the 1996 murder of rapper Tupac Shakur, begins on Monday, August 10, in Las Vegas. No one has ever been convicted in this case, which stands as one of the most famous cold cases in American history.

title: Tunisia, country of broken dreams: 'I wanted to photograph the young people whose lives began with the revolution'
subhead: 'Growing up in hostile environments' (3/7). Tunisian photographer Zied Ben Romdhane has documented his country since the fall of Ben Ali and the Arab Spring in late 2010. His work captures the deep malaise of a generation that has known only political turmoil and a lack of economic opportunities. Deprived of hope, on the edge of a sun-drenched sea, these young people dream solely of leaving.
